title: Biidaasige Park Grows with 10-Acre Waterfront Expansion in Toronto's Port Lands
summary: Toronto’s eastern waterfront continued its transformation today as officials celebrated the 10-acre western expansion of Biidaasige Park ahead of its public opening on Saturday, July 25. The addition expands what is already the city’s largest new park in a generation. The announcement followed a procession from the sacred fire circle to the lectern, led by the Spring Creek Dancers and Ojibwe singers, with traditional dance performances marking the park’s Indigenous foundations.
